title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: 22-bit comb delta on the Cheon class walk

claims.statement: At n=2^20, the Cheon six-class walk described in proof.md, using our twelve-digit 22-bit comb, recovers the protected secret with claimed probability at least 0.40 under the explicitly inherited random-mapping and final-window heuristics. Its hard-meter ceiling is less than 2^120.83 BLS G1 reference-operation equivalents, including cold preprocessing, failed paths, enlarged tables, recovery, verification and output. Peak storage is less than 2^35 bytes and nonuniform advice is zero. This is an analytic submitted bound, not a production execution or official result.
